mapper.select: SELECT cagg_name AS caggName, refreshed_until AS refreshedUntil, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM telemetry_cagg_refresh_state WHERE cagg_name = #{caggName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telemetry_cagg_refresh_state (cagg_name, refreshed_until, updated_at) VALUES (#{caggName}, #{refreshedUntil}, now()) ON CONFLICT (cagg_name) DO UPDATE SET refreshed_until = EXCLUDED.refreshed_until, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: CALL refresh_continuous_aggregate( CAST(#{caggName} AS regclass), CAST(#{windowStart} AS TIMESTAMPTZ), CAST(#{windowEnd} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) )
